LESSON: CHURCH UNITY

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Church
Topic 4.3: Church Unity

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Church Unity. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Church Unity
2. Practise Church Unity at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Church Unity

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Church Unity
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Church Unity. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Church Unity at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Church Unity at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Church Unity
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Church Unity. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Church Unity using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Church Unity in the examples.
2. Explain Church Unity to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Church Unity.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Church Unity using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Church Unity important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Church Unity
2. Practise Church Unity at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Church Unity

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
